purpose: Teach: あゆみ/つきあっ/すさまじい/このほど/とかく/ぬけ/かれこれ/めちゃめちゃ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのこれまでのあゆみ、すごいわね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather's life journey really has been remarkable, hasn't it.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful observation. Soft opening. A gentle smile in the voice. Slight pause before 'remarkable,' as if genuinely reflecting. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんと長くつきあってきたよ
lines.en: Mom, I've been spending time with Grandpa for a really long time.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Simple, earnest delivery with no performance. Small pride underneath—not boasting, just stating what's true. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、夕立がすさまじい降り方だったわね
lines.en: Sho, that sudden downpour earlier was really intense, wasn't it.
lines.style: Gentle shift in topic. Observational tone, noticing something natural. Slight wonder in the voice, as if remembering the sound of rain. No urgency, just present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、このほど絵のコンクールで賞をもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, I got a prize in an art contest recently.
lines.style: Soft pride. No loudness, but genuine. The words come out steadily, like he's checked that it's okay to share. Slight hesitation before 'prize,' as if wanting to make sure it matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはとかくお仕事のお話が長いのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad does tend to go on and on about work, doesn't he.
lines.style: Affectionate exasperation. Gentle tease in the voice, not complaint. A half-laugh underneath. Understanding and warmth for both of them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、走ってると靴下がぬけちゃうよ
lines.en: Mom, when I run my socks always slip off.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, delivered with a small wry amusement. No complaint—just noticing something odd about the world. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとぼくは、かれこれ十年お出かけしてるわね
lines.en: Sho, you and your dad have been taking outings together for about ten years now, haven't you.
lines.style: Warm remembrance. Slow, appreciative pace. A soft marvel in her voice at the time passed. Gentle recognition of something steady and real.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きをめちゃめちゃ頑張ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I really worked hard on my drawing.
lines.style: Earnest and glowing. Opening attack slightly brighter. Pride without loudness. The words come out full, wanting her to know he gave everything. Warmth at the close.
